Pokémon × Daniel Arsham | title_ja_trans="A Ripple in Time" by Pokémon × Daniel Arsham | broadcast_jp=February 12, 2022 | broadcast_us= | screen=hd | screenshot=A Ripple in Time.png | en_op= | ja_op=None | ja_ed=None | olmteam=Team Kato | scenario=湯山邦彦 | storyboard=湯山邦彦 | director=大和田淳 | art=一石小百合 | footnotes=* {{BMGf|291552|Original review thread on BMGf}} }} '''"A Ripple in Time" by Pokémon × Daniel Arsham''' is an [[List of animated series specials|animated series short]] produced as part of a [[Daniel Arsham × Pokémon|collaboration]] between {{wp|Daniel Arsham}} and [[The Pokémon Company]]. It was first released on February 12, 2022 on [[YouTube]], featuring Japanese audio and English subtitles. A teaser video for the short was released on January 28, 2022. The short was screened as part of the exhibition project '''A Ripple in Time''' (Japanese: '''時の波紋''' ''A Ripple in Time'') held at NANZUKA UNDERGROUND in {{wp|Tokyo}}, Japan from February 12 to March 27, 2022, and the exhibition '''Artifacts of Indigo Plateau''' (Chinese: '''石英高原的遗迹''' ''Artifacts of Indigo Plateau'') held at chi K11 art museum in {{wp|Shanghai}}, China from December 31, 2022 to May 7, 2023. {{spoilers}} ==Plot== {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|A Ripple in Time|Ash}} and {{DL|Ash Ketchum (A Ripple in Time)|Pikachu}} are facing [[Arsham|a Trainer]] and his {{p|Cubone}} in a battle at a stadium, with both Trainers being down to their last Pokémon. The match is unexpectedly interrupted by the appearance of a {{p|Celebi}}, and after a bright flash, Ash and Pikachu find themselves [[Time travel|in the future]], where the stadium is overgrown by trees. They see Celebi and follow it through an abandoned settlement and grasslands filled with crystallized Pokémon statues. Ultimately, their chase leads them to a mysterious shrine in a cave, where {{p|Dialga}} suddenly appears before them and roars. ==Major events== {{animeevents}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== [[File:Audience ARIT.png|250px|thumb|The audience containing cameo of several characters]] ===Humans=== * [[Ash Ketchum (A Ripple in Time)|Ash]] * {{an|Misty}} * {{an|Brock}} * [[Jessie]] * [[James]] * [[Gary Oak]] * {{an|Cynthia}} * [[Ritchie]] * {{an|Casey}} * [[Mother and daughter]] * [[Arsham]] * Crowd ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Ash Ketchum (A Ripple in Time)#Pikachu|Ash]]'s) * {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}}) * {{p|Togepi}} ({{OP|Misty|Togepi}}) * {{p|Garchomp}} ({{OP|Cynthia|Garchomp}}) * {{p|Cubone}} ([[Arsham]]'s) * {{p|Eevee}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Bulbasaur}} (Trainer's; ×2) * {{p|Squirtle}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Oddish}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Drowzee}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Poliwag}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Weedle}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Clefairy}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Sandshrew}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Jolteon}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Machop}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Growlithe}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Jigglypuff}} ([[Jigglypuff (anime)|''Pokémon the Series'']]) * {{p|Celebi}} * {{p|Mew}} * {{p|Dialga}} * {{p|Slowpoke}} * {{p|Butterfree}} (×3) * {{p|Pidgey}} (multiple) * {{p|Paras}} * {{p|Weedle}} ==Cast== {{cast/h|Hoso}} {{cast|Hoso|Ash Ketchum (A Ripple in Time)|disp=Ash|none|Satoshi|Rica Matsumoto|サトシ|松本梨香|top=yes}} {{cast|Hoso|Ash Ketchum (A Ripple in Time)#Pikachu|disp=Pikachu|none|Pikachu|Ikue Ohtani|ピカチュウ|大谷育江}} {{cast|Hoso|None|disp= |none| |List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Hina Natsume| |夏目妃菜}} {{cast|Hoso|None|disp= |none| |List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Yukiko Motoyoshi| |元吉有希子}} {{cast|Hoso|None|disp= |none| |Tatsuki Kobe| |光部樹|bottom=yes}} |} ==Staff== {{incomplete|section|Names in kanji}} {| class="credits-table roundy" style="width: 100%; background: #{{colorschemedark|Hoso}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemelight|Hoso}}" |- style="vertical-align: middle; background:#fff" !
